none: PAS FindID 1009017: Roman copper alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337), dating to AD 318-324.(Reece Period 16). SARMATIA DEVICTA reverse type depicting Victory advancing right, holding trophy and branch, trampling captive. Obverse description: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTINVS AVG]. Reverse description: Victory advancing right, holding trophy and branch, trampling captive. Reverse inscription: [SARMATIA] DEVI[CTA]. Diameter: 20.80 mm; Thickness 1.81 mm; Weight: 2.60g, DA = 12
